svg.title: Employee management: how the pieces fit — SoftTrack web design mockup (#128)
svg.desc: A map of the employee management epic: where each piece lives in the app, how the surfaces link, who reads and who writes each field, and the order they land in.
svg.text: Employee management: how the pieces fit

svg.text: Principles carried over: logic in lib_*, thin routes, an Alembic migration per schema change, openapi.json regenerated; every new column nullable; tenancy inside queries, never
post-filtered. Reviews, leave and onboarding stay out of scope, like workflow engines.
